aboutGame.title: What is Idle Breakout?
paragraphs: Idle Breakout is an addictive incremental arcade game created by Kodiqi that reimagines classic Atari brick breaking. Instead of manually defending a moving paddle, players purchase autonomous balls that bounce relentlessly inside an enclosed chamber, chipping away at numbered blocks to generate gold and unlock powerful scaling upgrades.

As brick health pools scale from simple numbers into millions and billions, success requires deep strategic synergy. Master six distinct ball types, activate game-changing power-up bursts, summon and conquer challenging bosses, and leverage prestige resets to acquire permanent multipliers and conquer infinite levels.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Idle Breakout.

items.question: What is Idle Breakout and how do you play it?
items.answer: Idle Breakout is an incremental arcade game by Kodiqi where you buy and upgrade bouncing balls to break numbered bricks. As blocks break, you earn gold to unlock faster, stronger balls, prestige multipliers, and skill trees.

items.question: What is the best ball in Idle Breakout?
items.answer: For early progression, the Plasma Ball provides excellent AoE clear. In the late game (Level 1,000+), the Sniper Ball and Cannon Ball dominate the meta with massive single-target and burst damage against high-HP bricks.

items.question: How does prestige work in Idle Breakout?
items.answer: Prestige resets your current stage and regular balls in exchange for Gold, a permanent meta-currency. Spending Gold on global power and speed multipliers allows you to blast past previous high levels in a fraction of the time.

items.question: What are Black Bricks used for in Idle Breakout?
items.answer: Black Bricks (BB) are rare, high-durability blocks that spawn during regular levels. Shattering them grants Black Bricks currency, which is spent in the Skills tab to summon Bosses and earn Skill Points for permanent passives.

items.question: Are there working save import codes for Idle Breakout?
items.answer: Yes, Idle Breakout supports serialized save codes that can be imported in the settings menu. These codes let you test endgame builds, unlock infinite cash, or jump straight to high levels like 10,000 or 42,000.
